dedupe_keys.name: tu delft list of cities and regions with open 3d city model datasets

description: The 3D geoinformation research group at TU Delft keeps a web table of cities and regions around the world that publish open 3D city model datasets, and invites contributions of further datasets. For each entry it lists country, year, building level of detail, other city object classes such as terrain, water or roads, whether textures are included, acquisition method and formats, with notes. Entries range from single cities such as Adelaide, Berlin, Boston, Helsinki, Montréal and New York to national or state datasets such as 3D BAG for all Dutch buildings, Estonia, North Rhine-Westphalia and Japan's PLATEAU with 329 cities as of March 2026, and a 125-million-building LoD1 set of American cities split by state. Coverage: global, with most entries in Europe, North America, Australia and Japan. Access: a single web page with links to each provider. Licence: page content; each listed dataset has its own terms. Caveats: the table is community maintained, so some links and years may be out of date. Simulation uses are finding 3D building geometry for a study area for solar, energy, flood and urban climate models. Related records: awesome-citygml, the CityJSON encoding and 3D BAG.
